concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-components-overview-after-payment-payouts-component]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace-path Platform Experience Payouts Overview/Details guide for role-scoped automatic-payout reporting, account/UTC+0 filters, report-coverage limits and versioned integration; UI is not bank-receipt proof.
warnings: The source is a Marketplace-path Adyen for Platforms component guide, not a Classic Platforms or payout-initiation API.
The raw describes net payout as bank credited, but the reporting UI does not independently establish beneficiary bank receipt.
The standalone Payout Details sample at raw lines 362-366 lacks a comma between `id` and `date`; treat it as illustrative.
